---
title: "Publications"
format:
  html: 
    toc: false
    page-layout: full
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://code.iconify.design/iconify-icon/1.0.7/iconify-icon.min.js"></script>
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script>
          (() => {
            const decode = (s) => {
              const el = document.createElement('textarea');
              el.innerHTML = s;
              return el.value;
            };

            // Fix authors (decode entities and bold)
            document.querySelectorAll('.publication-author').forEach((el) => {
              const decoded = decode(el.innerHTML);
              el.innerHTML = decoded.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
            });

            // Fix link blocks that were escaped into text
            document.querySelectorAll('.publication-links').forEach((el) => {
              const raw = el.textContent.trim();
              if (!raw) return;
              el.innerHTML = decode(raw);
            });

            // Fix DOI blocks only if they were escaped; leave real links intact
            document.querySelectorAll('.publication-doi').forEach((el) => {
              if (el.querySelector('a')) return;
              const raw = el.innerHTML;
              if (!raw || !raw.match(/&lt;|&gt;|&amp;/)) return;
              el.innerHTML = decode(raw);
            });

            // Remove any orphaned triple-colon artifacts Quarto leaves around listings
            document.querySelectorAll('p').forEach((p) => {
              if (p.textContent.trim() === ':::') {
                p.remove();
              }
            });
          })();
          </script>
listing:
  - id: pre-prints
    contents: publications.yaml
    include:
      categories: "Pre-print"
    template: ejs/citation.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: methodological

    template: ejs/citation.ejs

  - id: dissertation

    sort: "date desc"
